title: And deposits in every place
text: The transition `split` has the output spec `And(pack, invoice)`, so every firing puts one token in each of the two places. Then `ship` joins them again: its inputs are AND-joined, so it needs a token in `pack` and one in `invoice`.

steps.text: One `order` becomes a token in `pack` and a token in `invoice`. The built-in fork action copies the order's value into both.
Both inputs of `ship` are marked, so it joins them.
The second order forks the same way.
The places `pack` and `invoice` are empty: nothing is left to join.
